FRFrançais Give

Montréal, since 2014

Dear friend,

The Lord’s heart turns toward the least of these.

We are a group of Christians in Montréal who have chosen to resemble Him a little. We visit widows, bring bread to the street, notebooks to children, a prayer to whoever asks for one. Humbly, freely, for the glory of Elohim alone.

This letter is for you too. Read their stories, leave a prayer, write a word of encouragement. Every gesture counts.

Read their stories Support the work

With all our affection, the La Paix du Cœur team

P.S.

“Defend the weak and the fatherless; uphold the cause of the poor and the oppressed.” — Tehilim (Psalms) 82:3

Kimia na motema — peace of the heart, in Lingala.

Carry them in prayer

Leave a prayer request or a message of hope. Every message is read with care before it appears.

Prayer request

Seigneur, je te confie les enfants qui iront à l’école demain le ventre vide. Que quelqu’un les voie, et les nourrisse.

— Mireille · Nov 8

Message of hope

To whoever is reading this on a hard night: you are not forgotten. Morning comes. I’m praying for you right now.

— Anonymous · Nov 7

Prayer request

Pour ma mère, veuve depuis cet été. Qu’elle retrouve la joie, et le goût de chanter le dimanche.

— Anonymous · Nov 6

Four ways to love

What we offer, free of charge

Food

Grocery baskets, hot meals on outreach, supermarket food drives.

Clothing

Coats, boots and warm socks for the Québec winter.

Education

School supplies, homework help, support for students.

Material or financial

A discreet helping hand when life suddenly tips over.

Missions

A letter of encouragement

A few lines can warm a whole winter

Write to a child, a widow, someone met on street outreach. The team reads and hand-delivers every letter — never direct contact, never an exchange of addresses.
